name: duopore-public-multiline-record-splitter
description: Turn cells with several lines into separate rows while keeping track of their source.

interface.longDescription: Turn cells with several lines into separate rows while keeping track of their source. Paste your multiline cells and choose whether to trim spaces or keep blank lines. Each new row keeps its source ID and original line number. Use it to tidy a list before review or import. Each cell can contain up to 100 lines.
defaultPrompt: Split these multiline cells into separate records.
Keep each source ID and line number when splitting this list.

positive.prompt: Use Multiline Field Splitter with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"records":[{"recordId":"001","content":" apple\r\n\r\npear "}],"trimLines":true,"dropBlankLines":true}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
